top_signals.title: Yen Rises to Strongest Since May, Topping Intervention Rally
top_signals.summary: The yen strengthened to its highest level since February, surpassing the peak reached after coordinated intervention by Japan and the US.

top_signals.title: Spot bitcoin ETFs pull in $987 million last week as institutional demand recovers
top_signals.summary: Spot bitcoin ETFs drew in $3.52 billion in net inflows in August, their largest monthly positive flows since September 2025.
